title: imprintome-nf pipeline parameters
description: Illumina methylation array QC and genomic imprinting analysis with imprintomeR

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a CSV/TSV samplesheet with columns sample, idat_grn, idat_red and optional sample_group.
input.help_text: One row per array. idat_grn/idat_red point to the *_Grn.idat[.gz] and *_Red.idat[.gz] files of that array. sample_group is written to the Sample_Group metadata column and can be used with --reference_group.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

cohort.description: Cohort name, used as prefix for the metadata file and imprintomeR outputs.

platform.description: Override platform detection. By default the platform is detected from the IDATs and mixed cohorts are split by platform.

pcutoff.description: Detection p-value threshold: a sample passes when >= 95% of probes are detected at p < this value.

icutoff.description: Reference line for intensity QC plots only (does not affect Final.QC).

qc_plot_types.description: Comma-separated QC plot types: intensity, detection_pval, probe_coverage, qc_bar, beta_density, or all.

skip_qc_report.description: Suppress the default QC report PDFs from runMethQC().

skip_ewastools.description: Skip the ewastools control metrics, contamination and donor checks.

imprinting_options.title: Imprinting analysis options
imprinting_options.description: Options passed to imprintomeR's run_imprintomeR.R, run once per platform and probeset.

probesets.description: Comma-separated ICR probesets; each gets its own imprintomeR run.
probesets.help_text: Supported: selected, NanoImprint, Joshi, Court, Rosenski, Jima, chr11p15, chr20q13.

genome_build.description: Genome build used to load the probesets.

ids_cutoff.description: Imprinting Deviation Score (IDS) cutoff used for plot filtering.

reference_group.description: Comma-separated sample_group value(s) used as in-cohort controls for reference centring.

reference_file.description: External control reference: a beta matrix file or an .rds from BuildReferenceProfile().

dmr_type.description: DMR types to score: all, or comma-separated DMR_type values such as gametic or secondary. Default: panel default.

balance.description: Pooling for the sample-level IDS: probe (median over probes) or icr (ICR-balanced).

icr.description: Also score each ICR and write the per-ICR table and multi-locus summary.

infinium_type.description: Infinium probe design types to score.

imprint_plot_types.description: Comma-separated imprintomeR plot types, or default/all.
imprint_plot_types.help_text: Supported: polar, beeswarm, beeswarm_origin, beeswarm_chr, heatmap_by_probe, heatmap_by_gene, circular_heatmap, rainfall, radar, mirror_density, violin, cor_heatmap, icr_heatmap.

software_options.title: Software options
software_options.description: Container used by the imprintomeR processes.

imprintomer_container.description: Docker image or local .sif file with R, imprintomeR and its dependencies (see containers/imprintomer/Dockerfile).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
